physics: MCsquare default proton physics with nuclear interactions and secondary protons/deuterons/alphas enabled
source: single 150 MeV nominal-BDL spot (BDL_default_DN, not a commissioned beam model); gantry 0 (beam along +y of the CT); isocenter (60,150,60) mm
geometry: 60 x 150 x 60 voxels of 2 mm (x,y,z) = 120 x 300 x 120 mm water box; beam axis y; all HU 0
materials: Water_Phantom scanner conversion from the registered MCsquare runtime (HU 0 -> water)
cuts: E_Cut_Pro 0.5 MeV, D_Max 0.2 cm, Epsilon_Max 0.25, Te_Min 0.05 MeV (MCsquare defaults as shipped in the smoke case)
scorers: dose (Gy per primary? see native header)
units: native MHD headers; MCsquare dose output normalisation to be read from the log
rationale: Performance calibration reference for the proton-3d workload envelope (single thread) and a first independent-MC proton depth-dose in water; execution success is not physics validation
